as_told.title: Planned meeting with Lee Hively in Colorado Springs falls through

plain: Michels says a researcher named Lee Hively, who works in a field of physics called extended electrodynamics and lives in Colorado Springs, backed away when Michels tried to reach him. In one episode Michels says a friend helped make the contact, got in trouble, and Hively "freaked out," said he should not be contacted, and put the Navy's press office on the email thread; in another he tells it as a planned meeting that fell through when Hively "got very nervous" and the door was shut in his face. Michels tells both versions himself, and he takes it as a sign that the subject is sensitive.
